desc: Interiority - fear, held breath, the moment before.
prompt: a human heartbeat heard through a chest, a soft double thump low in frequency, repeating steadily, muffled as though through flesh, no room around it
negative: music, drums, kick drum, melody, speech, reverb
note: PARTIAL: there is no tempo conditioning. You get whatever rate the model chooses and it cannot accelerate with the scene, which is the only thing a heartbeat is ever asked to do. Generate this, cut ONE double-thump out, and repeat it in post at the rate you need. 'kick drum' is in the negative because at cfg 7 a periodic low pulse drifts musical fast.
